meta.name: defensive-programming
meta.description: Type safety practices including exhaustive checks, explicit return types, and Result-based error handling. Use when writing TypeScript logic that handles multiple cases or error conditions.

copy.tagline: 用类型安全实践编写更健壮的 TypeScript 逻辑
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果写 TypeScript 时常因类型不严谨或遗漏分支而出错
copy.tagline_en: Write more robust TypeScript logic with type safety practices
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often encounter bugs due to loose typing or missing branches in TypeScript

howto.what: Claude 会强制 TypeScript 代码覆盖所有分支，显式声明返回类型，使用 exhaustive switch 或类型映射确保完整性；用 Result 类型处理错误，避免异常抛出。
howto.when: 当编写 TypeScript 逻辑需要处理多个分支或错误条件时自动触发。

say.text: 帮我检查这个 switch 是否覆盖了所有 case。
say.note: Claude 会分析并补全遗漏分支。

say.text: 用 Result 类型重写这个错误处理，不要用 try-catch。

howto.what_en: Claude enforces exhaustive branch coverage, explicit return types, exhaustive switch or type-mapping in TypeScript code, and uses Result type for error handling instead of exceptions.
howto.when_en: Triggered when writing TypeScript logic that handles multiple cases or error conditions.

say_en.text: Check if this switch covers all cases.
say_en.note: Claude analyzes and adds missing branches.

say_en.text: Rewrite this error handling with Result type, no try-catch.
